SINGLE ZONE CV HEAT PUMP AHU SEQUENCE OF OPERATIONS
TYPICAL FOR AHU-1, AHU-2, AHU-3

GENERAL
1. THE UNIT SHALL CONTROL TO ZONE TEMPERATURE. THE AHU IS PAIRED WITH A SPLIT HEAT PUMP CONDENSING UNIT. THE REHEAT ELEMENT IS LOCATED DOWNSTREAM OF THE FAN.
2. COMPRESSORS AND ELECTRIC HEAT ARE STAGED WITH AN INTERSTAGE DELAY OF 3 MINUTES.

CONTROL SYSTEM
1. THE UNIT SHALL BE CONTROLLED BY THE BMS. THE BMS SHALL MONITOR SUPPLY FAN STATUS, RETURN AIR HUMIDITY, MIXED AIR TEMPERATURE AND FILTER STATUS.

OCCUPIED MODE
1. THE SUPPLY FAN SHALL RUN CONTINUOUSLY. THE BMS SHALL MAINTAIN A SUPPLY AIR TEMPERATURE SETPOINT OF 58°F. THE ELECTRIC HEATER SHALL MODULATE TO HOLD THE COOLING SETPOINT.
2. ELECTRIC HEAT SHALL BE THE FIRST STAGE OF HEATING. THE HEAT PUMP SHALL BE ENABLED AS THE SECOND STAGE.
3. MINIMUM ON OFF TIME SHALL BE 3 MINUTES.
4. LOCAL TENANT OVERRIDE SHALL PLACE THE UNIT IN OCCUPIED MODE.

LOCKOUTS
1. THE COMPRESSOR SHALL BE LOCKED OUT FOR COOLING AND HEATING BELOW 20°F OUTSIDE AIR TEMPERATURE AND THE SUPPLY FAN SHALL NOT START.

AUXILIARY HEAT
1. AUXILIARY HEAT SHALL BE ENABLED WHEN ALL OF THE FOLLOWING CONDITIONS ARE MET: THE HEAT PUMP IS AT FULL CAPACITY, OR HEAT PUMP HEATING IS LOCKED OUT. REFER TO DEFROST CONTROL SECTION.

UNOCCUPIED MODE
1. THE SUPPLY FAN SHALL CYCLE TO MAINTAIN UNOCCUPIED SETPOINTS OF 80°F AND 65°F. ALL DAMPERS SHALL CLOSE.

SAFETIES
1. SMOKE DETECTORS SHALL STOP THE UNIT.
2. SUPPLY FAN START/STOP/STOP SHALL BE MONITORED.

ALARMS
1. THE BMS SHALL ALARM ON FILTER STATUS AND SUPPLY FAN FAILURE.
